summary: Pelican Aqua Holding Plc, through its subsidiaries, operates as a builder of large-capacity wellboats for the global salmon farming industry in Cyprus and Inernationally. It owns wellboats carrying, treating, and harvesting live fish and servicing fish farming companies. It provide business-critical services to salmon farmers, including transportation and biological treatment of fish. Pelican Aqua Holding Plc was formerly known as SNC Winther Holdings Ltd and changed its name to Pelican Aqua Holding Plc in May 2026. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is based in Limassol, Cyprus.
